SELECT ec.ev_charger_id, ec.parking_spot_id, ec.charger_type, ec.charger_status, ec.create_time,
split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) AS floor,
CASE split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) WHEN '1F' THEN 'B1' WHEN '2F' THEN 'B2' WHEN '3F' THEN 'B3' WHEN '4F' THEN 'B4' WHEN '5F' THEN 'B5' ELSE split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) END AS floor_label,
CASE ec.charger_status WHEN 'STANDBY' THEN '대기' WHEN 'CHARGING' THEN '사용 중' WHEN 'CHECK' THEN '점검' WHEN 'RISK' THEN '위험' WHEN 'FAULT' THEN '고장' WHEN 'POWER_OFF' THEN '전원 차단' ELSE ec.charger_status END AS status_label FROM ev_charger ec
split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) = #{floor}
ORDER BY split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1), ec.ev_charger_id

SELECT ec.ev_charger_id, ec.parking_spot_id, ec.charger_type, ec.charger_status, ec.create_time,
split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) AS floor,
CASE split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) WHEN '1F' THEN 'B1' WHEN '2F' THEN 'B2' WHEN '3F' THEN 'B3' WHEN '4F' THEN 'B4' WHEN '5F' THEN 'B5' ELSE split_part(ec.ev_charger_id, '-', 1) END AS floor_label,
CASE ec.charger_status WHEN 'STANDBY' THEN '대기' WHEN 'CHARGING' THEN '사용 중' WHEN 'CHECK' THEN '점검' WHEN 'RISK' THEN '위험' WHEN 'FAULT' THEN '고장' WHEN 'POWER_OFF' THEN '전원 차단' ELSE ec.charger_status END AS status_label FROM ev_charger ec WHERE ec.ev_charger_id = #{evChargerId}

WITH hours AS ( SELECT generate_series(1, 24) AS hour_label ), hourly_kwh AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time)::int + 1 AS hour_label, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_charge_kwh), 0), 2) AS hourly_kwh FROM ev_charging_log WHERE DATE(start_time) BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{endDate}::date GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time) ) SELECT h.hour_label, COALESCE(k.hourly_kwh, 0) AS hourlyKwh FROM hours h LEFT JOIN hourly_kwh k ON h.hour_label = k.hour_label ORDER BY h.hour_label

SELECT ev_charging_log_id, ev_charger_id, vehicle_number, start_time, end_time, current_charge_kwh, total_charge_kwh, charging_status, end_reason, CASE WHEN end_time IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time)) / 60) ELSE NULL END AS chargingMinutes FROM ev_charging_log
DATE(start_time) BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{endDate}::date
AND charging_status = #{status}
ORDER BY start_time DESC
